title: Leaching Vat
pages: Fire an iron block in the kiln to make steel billets, then press billets into sealed steel plates. Build an Ore Sluice and wash four cobbled deepslate into graded filter media. Enclose one media in a copper frame with four copper ingots at the crafting-grid corners and four iron nuggets on the edges to make a Framed Filter Strainer. Build a Seam Press and seam four leather into a Clamped Liner, then emboss it in the powered Pressure Press (140 ticks, 10 FE/t) into an Embossed Wear Liner. Charge a sky-exposed Astral Font to at least 120 lumen and hold one sealed steel plate on it to consecrate a Brine Ward; this is the aqueous tier's required magic step and no machine makes the ward. The aqueous tier also needs its own workshop before the vat: attune one amethyst shard (or another listed batch) on a formed Sanctum Pylon into an Attuned Starshard, fire bricks in the Foundry Ring into a Fired Foundry Liner, screen four sand on the Rotary Screen into Screened Silica, compact four redstone in the Compaction Spire into a Compacted Electrode, and cure leather on the Provision Hearth into Cured Lashing. Craft the vat with Embossed Wear Liner/Copper Flow Valve/Attuned Starshard, Foundry Liner/Framed Filter Strainer/Screened Silica, Compacted Electrode/Brine Ward/Cured Lashing. A loose bucket, an unpressed valve blank, raw gravel, loose filter media or bare plates cannot substitute for the framed strainer, pressed wear liner or the five workshop parts, and annealed copper or a bare plate cannot replace the Brine Ward. The frame protects the vat feed from coarse particles; mesh aperture and clogging are abstracted. Supply water, FE and item input as described below; the strainer is part of the controller, not a separate inventory slot. Form a Copper Valve Blank from two copper ingots, two iron nuggets and a leather seal, then finish it in the Copper Hot Press (180 ticks, 12 FE/t). The pressed valve controls the vat feed; a loose bucket cannot replace it.

Insert the solid ingredient on the left and extract the result on the right. Supply water with a bucket by right-clicking the vat or connect a Forge fluid pipe to its 8000 mB tank. Each batch consumes its recipe water (usually 250 mB) on completion. Supply FE or use the crank; most batches take 100 ticks at 8 FE/t. Work pauses if water, power or output room is missing. While processing, the basin brightens with lime-green bubbles, casts a dim light and makes a wet bubbling sound. It quiets and darkens after 20 idle ticks; a dry or unpowered vat stays quiet.

The vat washes raw ores and grits, extracts useful minerals, reclaims shards and powders from blocks and treats soil and stone. JEI lists each solid input, water cost, time and output. Its datapack recipe type is arcana_industry:leaching with ingredient, optional count, fluid, fluid_amount, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins, then recipe ID. Raw iron, copper and gold and their grits wash in batches of four into five ingots, a better yield than the furnace.

Top and horizontal item faces accept input; bottom exports output. Configure each item face in the menu. All faces expose FE and the internal fluid tank. Inventory, FE, water, progress and item ports survive saves. Breaking drops solid contents.

Leach a dried kelp block to collect purified salts. The salts are required to craft the t4 electrolyzer; electrolysis of more salts produces conductive crystals for the next stage. Niobium Grit cannot be furnace-smelted: leach each grit with 500 mB water (180 ticks, 12 FE/t) into a Niobium Oxide Cake, then reduce the cake in a Kiln at 1000 heat. Chain Crusher output into the vat input face and route bottom output to the Kiln top with hoppers.

The Embossed Wear Liner is a controller craft component, not a consumable slot. A loose Clamped Liner cannot replace it. Make the liner through the Seam Press and Pressure Press before building the vat; JEI lists the powered Press step. For automated batches, feed solids through an input face, water through the fluid capability and FE through an energy face; extract results from the bottom.
